description: This file contains functions related to the Drupal Views UI module, specifically for AJAX interactions, form handling, and display configuration within the Views UI.

methods.name: views_ui_add_ajax_trigger
methods.description: Adds AJAX behavior and a fallback submit button to a form element for dynamic updates.

methods.name: views_ui_add_limited_validation
methods.description: Limits validation errors for a non-JavaScript fallback submit button to specific form parts.

methods.name: views_ui_add_ajax_wrapper
methods.description: Wraps a form region in a div for AJAX refreshes after the form is built.

methods.name: views_ui_ajax_update_form
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to update parts of the add view form dynamically.

methods.name: views_ui_nojs_submit
methods.description: Fallback handler for form submission when JavaScript is disabled, triggers a form rebuild.

methods.name: views_ui_standard_display_dropdown
methods.description: Adds a dropdown to select default or overridden display configurations in Views UI.

methods.name: views_ui_build_form_url
methods.description: Constructs a URL for the Views UI form based on form state and parameters.

methods.name: views_ui_form_button_was_clicked
methods.description: Determines if a button was the form's trigger, supporting multiple #values.
